facts.business: Dharti Proteins Limited is a company that underwent Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) and was revived pursuant to a Resolution Plan approved by NCLT Ahmedabad Bench on November 18, 2025.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in the provided text
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on NCLT-approved Resolution Plan effects including waiver/extinguishment of liabilities, restructuring of debts, cancellation and issuance of equity shares, write-off of assets, infusion of funds, and statutory dues dealt with per Resolution Plan; Disclaimer of Opinion on Internal Financial Controls over Financial Reporting (Annexure B)

key_risks: Company was under CIRP and revived via NCLT-approved Resolution Plan
Existing shares cancelled and new shares allotted to new promoters and creditors
Statutory dues and government demands continue on portals but dealt with in books per Resolution Plan
Disclaimer of Opinion on Internal Financial Controls over Financial Reporting
